known_deviations.source: VLDB 2022 TranAD; the two-phase transformer with focus-score self-conditioning is transcribed from github.com/imperial-qore/TranAD (src/models.py, main.py:backprop).
known_deviations.protocol_note: The release thresholds these scores with POT (src/pot.py: SPOT with the per-dataset lm_d and lr_d in src/params.json). This harness reports its percentile reference protocol here, and POT is applied separately by scripts/mtsad/score_pot.py, because folding a different threshold rule into the model comparison would confound the two.

boundary: Full local baseline comparison, not historical author-harness equivalence; original known deviations remain explicit. USAD signed-loss control may be unstable and must be reported as such.
